search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 38074 (Forest Laboratories), CIK 1578845 (Actavis plc / Allergan plc) and CIK 1551152 (AbbVie) via data.sec.gov/submissions; fetched every Forest 10-Q/10-K and 8-K item 2.02 exhibit filed 2008-01 to 2014-07, every Actavis/Allergan 8-K item 2.02 exhibit filed 2014-10 to 2020-06 plus the 2020Q1 10-Q, and every AbbVie 8-K item 2.02 exhibit filed 2020-07 to 2026-09.

Forest prints Bystolic only in prose until its fiscal-2014 10-Qs: 2008Q2-2008Q4 are read from the fiscal-2009 10-Q MD&A (USD thousands; the releases of that year print whole dollars), 2009Q1-2014Q1 from the earnings-release sentence 'Sales of Bystolic ... were $X million' / 'Bystolic ... recorded sales of $X million' (USD millions). Forest's fiscal quarters end on calendar quarter ends (fiscal year ends March 31).

series_end_reason: Allergan plc's last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2020 (filed 2020-05-07); AbbVie completed the acquisition on May 8, 2020 and Allergan filed Form 15-12B on 2020-05-21 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1578845/000119312520148719/d896295d1512b.htm). None of AbbVie's 46 earnings-release exhibits (8-K item 2.02) filed 2020-07 to 2026-09 prints a Bystolic row, so no issuer prints the product's own line after 2020Q1.

unreported_quarters.2014Q2: Ownership change Forest Laboratories to Actavis plc; no full-quarter figure is published. Actavis completed the acquisition of Forest on July 1, 2014; Forest filed no report for its fiscal quarter ended June 30, 2014 (its last periodic report is the fiscal-2014 Form 10-K/A of 2014-06-30, and it filed Form 15-12B on 2014-07-15, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/38074/000119312514268315/d759326d1512b.htm). Actavis's 2014Q2 release (8-K filed 2014-08-05) predates the acquisition and its 8-Ks of 2014-08-05 and 2014-09-30 print no Bystolic sales. The Forest-issued series therefore ends at 2014Q1 (fiscal 2014 fourth quarter, January-March 2014); Actavis plc / Allergan plc's own Bystolic line from 2014Q3 is staged separately as allergan_bystolic, and the two join across the unreported 2014Q2. | Continuation of forest_bystolic (Forest Laboratories, 2008Q2-2014Q1) after the change of ownership. Ownership change Forest Laboratories to Actavis plc; no full-quarter figure is published. Actavis completed the acquisition of Forest on July 1, 2014; Forest filed no report for its fiscal quarter ended June 30, 2014 (its last periodic report is the fiscal-2014 Form 10-K/A of 2014-06-30, and it filed Form 15-12B on 2014-07-15, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/38074/000119312514268315/d759326d1512b.htm). Actavis's 2014Q2 release (8-K filed 2014-08-05) predates the acquisition and its 8-Ks of 2014-08-05 and 2014-09-30 print no Bystolic sales. The Actavis/Allergan series therefore starts at 2014Q3, the first full quarter after the July 1, 2014 close; the launch-to-2014Q1 history is the Forest piece.

series_start_reason: Bystolic was launched on January 28, 2008, in Forest's fiscal fourth quarter (January-March 2008). Forest printed no Bystolic figure for that quarter: the April 2008 release mentions only launch expenses, and fiscal 2009 Bystolic sales of $69.2 million (2009-04-21 release) equal the four fiscal-2009 quarters (4.374 + 14.163 + 20.961 + 29.7), so the first printed quarter is 2008Q2 (April-June 2008), one quarter after launch.
